summary: Clayton County lookout entry tied to a Henry County tower; a 2012 plan would move it to Reynolds Nature Preserve. No source confirms the move.

facts.status_note: A 2012 plan would move the former Henry County tower to Reynolds Nature Preserve near Morrow. No source confirms that the move happened.

events.note: FFLA first restoration grant of 2012 went toward restoring and relocating the tower; the report describes the move as planned

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2012 FFLA report gives an LS-40 and the Forest Lookouts index gives an MC-40; both describe a 100-foot Aermotor, and the sources do not settle which is right.
The list note 'GA109-relocated' reads as a completed move, but the 2012 reports describe a planned move; the story treats the move as planned and unconfirmed.

notes_for_editor: The link between this entry and the Henry County tower (list code GA109, called greenwood) rests on the list note and the 2012 reports; see us-ga-greenwood. The 2012 sources describe a plan. No source found places a tower at the preserve now, and the Wikipedia article on the preserve (checked 2026-10-21) does not mention a tower or lookout. Clayton County Parks and Recreation is the place to confirm. Preserve facts come from Wikipedia, not a county page.
